data.define: A mix of hungry and angry, for when hunger ruins your mood.

misuse.text: Don't say you're 'hangry' at a job interview.

publish.title: What does "hangry" mean?
publish.value: Hangry = Angry because you're hungry. Example: "Feed me, I'm hangry!" (casual English).
